title: voice-spiral-compendium-solution-sketches-mar-2026
summary: Compact synthesis of ~48 voice-related asks collected between Jan-Mar 2026 across support tickets, CSM interviews, and product feedback sessions. Goal: cluster requests into 6 actionable lanes, propose 7 quick patches (<=2 dev days), and outline a prioritized engineering roadmap to present to Product and Eng next week.
synthesized_findings: Latency sensitivity dominates: 60% of production customers call out tail latency spikes when using short prompts + streaming; they prefer predictable 200-400ms token latency over best-case faster but spiky behavior.

Verbosity/format drift: customers building assistant UIs report models changing response length and structure between model versions; request 'format guarantees' or structured response modes for stable downstream parsing.

Embedding/semantic search mismatch: voice apps that transcribe audio then embed are seeing lower retrieval precision because transcriptions add noise; clients ask for embedding-tuned ASR or capture-level metadata flags.
Observability gaps: customers ask for per-call audio + token-level tracing and cost attribution (so they can tie audio-minute usage to token costs in billing).
On-device/offline hybrid asks: a subset (regulated and edge) want a local small model for fallback + cloud for heavy-lift generations with a deterministic routing policy.
prioritized_requests: Stabilized-structured-output-mode (HIGH signal, MED effort): enforce schema-first generation with mild sampling constraints; promise 95% compliance on targeted prompts. Ticket: CSREQ-981.
Tail-latency-smoothing toggles (HIGH signal, HIGH effort): per-customer config to prioritize consistent latency via smaller batch sizes + KV cache heuristics; suggested canary on Dedicated first.
ASR->embedding pipeline flags (MED signal, MED effort): add 'raw_transcript_confidence' and 'punctuation_hint' metadata on embedding requests to improve retrieval scoring; low-impact shim in SDK.
Per-call audio artifact retention opt-in (MED signal, LOW effort): short-term retention toggle for storing audio snippets for 7/30 days for debugging; must include consent checkbox in Console.
Rollback-safe model pins for voice routes (HIGH signal, LOW effort): route names that can pin to model-version sets and automatically fallback to last-known-good on mismatch regressions.
Billing attribution by audio-minute + token (LOW signal, MED effort): engineering to add token-metering labels to audio ingestion and expose to billing export.
Edge-fallback pattern docs + tiny-runtime sample (MED signal, LOW effort): create reference architecture for hybrid offline/online voice apps (example using private-deployments).
quick_patches: Add 'structured_output' boolean on /chat endpoints and pass through to model prompting layer — target: 2 dev days to prototype (owner: DevX).
Expose 'latency_preference' header that maps to runtime batching heuristics; implement two modes: 'snappy' and 'stable' — prototype for Dedicated customers first.
Console: add toggle 'retain-audio-for-debug' on per-route settings (UI + API) — quick frontend + flagging in backend.
SDK: include transcript_confidence metadata in embed() helper for client-side prefiltering — minor lib bump.
Docs: publish 'voice-routing-playbook' (1 pager) with recommended prompts to reduce format drift — product writes, CS reviews.
Monitoring: add a 'voice-tail-latency' panel in Console (95/99p token latency for streaming flows) — SRE + Observability.
Support: standardize triage template for audio tickets (fields: sample id, model version, transcript, timestamp, route config) to reduce back-and-forth.
open_questions: How much SLA budget do we have to reallocate to smoothing tail latency without degrading throughput on shared pools? (ask Eng infra).
Should structured-output be an explicit API mode (affects pricing/SLAs) or an implementation hint for prompt engineering? (ask Product).
What privacy constraints apply to retained audio across EU customers and UK-GDPR specifics? (Legal/Compliance to confirm).
Can we wire transcript confidence into existing ranking pipelines without retraining indexers? (Search infra input).
Are Dedicated customers willing to accept slightly higher per-token costs for 'stable' latency mode? (sales/CS to surface).
next_steps: Present this compendium + top 3 asks to Product + Serving Runtime on 2026-03-22 (owner: Asha).
Kick off a 2-week quick-patch sprint for the 3 low-effort items (structured_output, retain-audio toggle, transcript metadata) — create Epic CS-VOICE-QP and link to JIRA CSREQ-981.
Schedule legal review for audio retention policy by 2026-03-20 (owner: Lucia).
Run a short Dedicated canary for latency_preference with 2 pilot customers (Jon to coordinate with Sales).
Create short customer-facing note (FAQ + expected timeline) to send to pilots and affected customers — draft by Ravi.
